crime: Every evening a girl sat on the rim of the courtyard fountain, bare feet in the water, her cardigan folded unworn beside her. She couldn't sleep until she was cold through. {WITCH_NAME} leaned on the upper railing above, her Magic prickling her own arms with the cold of the girl unseen in the dark. It was the one cold she let herself keep. The prisoners laughed as she called out each dip of those feet, never wrong: the girl always came up wet to the ankles.

One evening the girl came up, took {WITCH_NAME}'s goosebumped arms in both hands and rubbed them. "Nobody likes being cold." {WITCH_NAME} said nothing. As a child she had stood barefoot at an open window, snow blowing in; her mother had rubbed her arms the same way, said the same words, and shut it. She never opened a window on the cold again.
"Tomorrow's my last evening out," the girl promised. "So you'll never have to freeze for me again."
At eight that last evening, {WITCH_NAME} went down and held the girl's face under the water, feeling the icy water fill her own chest. She didn't let go until the girl was still.

At twenty past, back at the railing, she called out the dip of the girl's feet, as always. At half past, she clutched her chest: "Someone's holding her under!" The girls beside her heard nothing from the dark. They ran down and found the girl face down in the basin, drowned in her cardigan with her shoes on.

In the trial court, the prisoners ruled that someone in the dark had held her under at half past eight while {WITCH_NAME} stood with them. One prisoner pointed out the socks inside the girl's shoes: dry, though {WITCH_NAME} had said her feet went in. The prisoners saw it then: no feet had gone in, so she had made up that echo to stand among them while the girl already lay drowned.
fields.epitaph: She never told the one girl who loved the cold as much as she did. One sentence, and they could have sat in the cold together.
execution: The execution stand raises a knitted cardigan as tall as the trial court, hanging open. She stands barefoot inside its open front. Its sleeves fold around her bare arms, and the goosebumps on them smooth away. Then the cardigan buttons itself shut from hem to collar, and its sleeves wind around her face and draw tight. It hangs there, still buttoned to the collar, until her bare feet stop moving below the hem.

magic.name: Gentle Echo
magic.text: She feels the chill, thirst, hunger, aches and tastes of people near her as if they were her own.
